# Instructions for AI coding agents working on relaybaton

relaybaton is a small Python CLI (`baton`) with no runtime dependencies.

## Build and test

```bash
python3.11 -m venv .venv && . .venv/bin/activate
pip install -e . pytest==8.3.4 pytest-cov==6.0.0 ruff==0.8.6
ruff check . && ruff format --check .
python -m pytest --cov
```

## Rules

- Standard library only. Do not add runtime dependencies.
- Every behaviour change needs a test; keep coverage at or above 90%.
- Any path read from `baton.toml` must go through `Config.path()` so it stays
  inside the repository.
- Call git with argument lists, never `shell=True`.
- Edit this file, not CLAUDE.md, GEMINI.md or .github/copilot-instructions.md.
  Run `baton sync` afterwards.
- Record anything the next agent or person needs in HANDOFF.md with
  `baton handoff add`.
